body.objective: Determine whether the globally populated finite-flux axial Schwarzschild channel bundle admits a nontrivial symmetry-compatible positive pseudo-Hermitian/CPT metric.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal global finite-flux channel classification. If no additional physical channel survives, certify the CPT question as non-applicable on that quotient and stop. Otherwise define the real-field antilinear involution and the action-derived indefinite endpoint form on the exact channel bundle. Seek a Hermitian eta_ell(omega)>0 that is smooth or meromorphic on every resolved real-frequency cell, obeys eta(-omega)=conjugate(eta(omega)), is rotation/parity invariant, descends through the BRST/gauge quotient, has controlled low/high-frequency limits within the declared window, and is preserved by the full boundary evolution or incoming-to-outgoing relation actually constructed. Distinguish generic quasi-Hermiticity from Mannheim's stronger C,P,T data: if claiming CPT, construct an antilinear involution Theta and a linear involution C with Theta^2=C^2=1, [Theta,H]=[C,H]=0 and a positive induced form. Give an exact structured-cone parameterization and one explicit algebraic positive solution, or an exact infeasibility witness. Prove that any result extends to the certified compactly supported wave-packet completion. Include the Hamiltonian-Hopf counterflow quartet as an exact broken-PT negative control, but do not use it as evidence about Schwarzschild.
body.current_gate: Positive structured metric on the actual global finite-flux channel bundle
body.forbid: no arbitrary pointwise diagonalization metric; no separate eta chosen discontinuously at each frequency; no positive matrix called Mannheim CPT without C/P/T involutions; no finite-dimensional formal block substituted for the global channel quotient; no radial-current metric substituted for endpoint flux; no positivity called unitarity, Hadamard, pole-freeness or nonlinear stability
body.resource_hint: Use invariant Gram and quotient maps from the channel classifier. A positive eta for a finite diagonalizable matrix with real spectrum is not by itself a physical result; the frequency regularity, real structure, symmetry and quotient constraints are essential.
notes: This is conditional: zero globally surviving additional channels is a terminal non-applicability result, not a failed search.
A pseudo-Hermitian pass does not establish a BRST-compatible Hadamard state or interacting unitarity.
